The Artist

HC

Harshith Challa is a 3D artist focused on lighting, look development, and product visualization — building imagery that reads as photographic even when nothing in the frame is real. The work spans character studies, product renders, and full environment builds, always led by how light moves through a scene before anything else is decided.
